readout.boundedResult: no supported omission found in this one original

limitations: Static reads and literal-source parsing only; no browser, build, test, campaign, mutation, install, remote job or integration edit.
Production path, construction, observations and registered checks are source-traced intentions; no claim that setup succeeded, a path ran, reach was measured, a check passed or a mutant was killed.

Compared with the original local Vitest helpers, every migrated helper check now requires browser-source transformation, browser/application fixture and cookie setup (browser-driver-oracle.ts:21,37–51,65–94). Code-block default-source/selection observations additionally occur after awaited authenticated fragment preview (editor-code-block.oracle.test.ts:62; browser-driver-oracle.ts:264–269). Setup/interaction success and completion of these later checkpoints remain unmeasured; a setup failure is not a law rejection or passing behavior evidence.
Models are read independently against this original; production output is not authority. No new law or usefulness judgment is made.

Candidate AGENTS.md was read in full. Its external environment/session documents were not brought into this isolated packet review; no environment operation or session/deployment action was attempted.
A fresh source-only pass still selects an interpretation of asserted observations; token-tree equivalence for the list HTML predicate is a static argument, not a renderer execution.
No sibling original tests, other scanners directories, earlier audits or other scanner conclusions were read.
Source provenance notes referring to earlier restoration decisions were read only inside executable candidate law blocks; they do not establish runtime or deletion acceptance.

commonTransport.semantics: Exact supplied production module source is compiled into a factory; browserRun installs it on a Playwright page; browserCall spreads the provided args directly into sut[method]. No DOM editing event is required by these helper-level originals. Markdown list/verse rendering remains default MarkdownIt in Node as in the original.
commonTransport.argumentFidelity: Original formatEdit calls have four arguments; indentEdit four with explicit false/true; formatKey two with explicit platform boolean; structureKey one explicit event object; formulaEdit, breakEdit and codeBlockEdit three. Candidate uses the same counts and values. No original optional argument is silently replaced by an explicit alternative.
commonTransport.guaranteeBoundary: Named constructions are statically registered through histories.constructed/build in the same property as generated cases; this is a guaranteed input if that property executes, not probabilistic random coverage and not an observed runtime guarantee.

single.facts: result.output (complete source), result.selection (both offsets), result.usable; error

multi.facts: result.output (complete source), result.selection (both offsets), result.usable; error

link.facts: result.output (complete source), result.selection (both offsets), result.usable; error

formula.facts: result.output (complete source), result.selection (both offsets), result.usable; error

list.args: [text, from, to, out] (out explicitly false or true)
list.facts: result.edit (including literal null and both selection offsets), result.output (complete source); error

nest.facts: result.tight, structure (ordered tokens including first-child ancestry/body), noCode, noPre; selected text and caretAtEnd; error

break.facts: edit (complete edit including caret), output (complete source); error

verse.facts: verse.output, verse.html (full default MarkdownIt HTML), verse.carets (every edit); error

code.facts: defaultSource (full source for all six original inputs); selection.text, afterNewline, beforeNewline, bodyStart/bodyEnd (exact body geometry)

key.facts: result.format and result.structure including null; error

original.expression: expect(formatKey(key('b', { ctrlKey: true, shiftKey: true }), false)).toBeNull();
